definitions.gloss: (not) at all; utterly; completely (with a negative or a negative word)
definitions.explanation: A casual intensifier meaning "not at all" with a negative verb, and "utterly, hopelessly" with words like {駄目|だめ} (no good) or {下手|へた} (bad at). Conversational; it sounds blunter and more dismissive than {全然|ぜんぜん}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧てんでわからない。
examples.english: I don't understand maths at all.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧てんで⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}たない→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: No matter how often I tell him, my brother won't listen at all.

notes:
Informal; avoid it in polite or written language, where ⟦{全|まった}く→全く：02363_mattaku⟧ or ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ fits.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- てんで{駄目|だめ}: hopeless, no good at all
- てんで⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧: not even worth discussing
- てんで⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧にしない: to pay someone no attention at all

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧: not at all; the everyday, neutral word
- ⟦ちっとも→ちっとも：01663_chittomo⟧: not a bit; casual, often with a note of complaint
- ⟦さっぱり→さっぱり：02777_sappari⟧: (not) at all, especially of understanding or results
